description: Ingest inline items (items / items_jsonl / text) or a JSONL/text file (source) via the batch-create path; returns real counts and refuses malformed input. (READ-ONLY: mutations refused)

galaxy.description: Galaxy for items without an explicit source (default: codex)

items.description: Array of items: strings, or objects {content, source?, kind?, tags?, importance?}

items_jsonl.description: Newline-delimited JSONL items, or plain non-empty text lines

redact.description: Scrub credential-shaped tokens before storage (default true).

source.description: Optional path to a JSONL or text file (same line rules as items_jsonl)

name: memory.ingest
title: Ingest Memories
